description: List football competition and league API keys. Returns featured major competitions when query is omitted. With query (e.g. World Cup, Premier League), filters featured list or searches footapi. FIFA World Cup key is WorldCupBrazil2014 — use with get_league_fixtures (not get_fixtures, which returns empty for cups). ALWAYS call this before fetching fixtures when the user names a league or tournament.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

query.description: Optional filter (e.g. World Cup, Premier League, Champions League). Omit for all featured competitions with keys.

name: list_competitions
